rationale: Plan addresses both self-review findings from attempt 1. The data caveat disclosure is essential for transparency when the report is shared with the sponsor. Showing denominators alongside rates provides necessary evidence for the denial and fraud statistics, improving clarity and trust.
changes_summary: Two parameters in write_report were revised: (1) added "synthetic_data" to caveats to disclose that the data is synthetic (high-severity finding), and (2) set show_denominators to true to display numerator/denominator pairs for rates rather than proportions alone (medium-severity finding). All other components remain unchanged.
